text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph argument with examples and rebuttal","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how clearly the essay develops its points in an ordered structure rather than moving from one idea to another loosely."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like 'As a student I can say' and 'However, teacher's opinion matter too'","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures how effectively the essay uses transitions and linking phrases to connect ideas across paragraphs."},{"evidence":"extended explanation of school week effects on students, teachers, and staff","quality":"development","description":"This captures how much the essay elaborates claims with supporting details and reasons instead of making brief unsupported statements."},{"evidence":"wording such as 'advantages and disavantages' and 'we don't have guarantee'","quality":"academic register","description":"This captures a more school-appropriate argumentative tone with attempts at formal explanation rather than casual conversational framing."},{"evidence":"uses comparative reasoning and cause-effect phrasing","quality":"reasoning complexity","description":"This captures the ability to weigh tradeoffs and explain consequences in a more nuanced way."},{"evidence":"more varied sentence patterns and longer controlled sentences","quality":"syntactic control","description":"This captures greater command of sentence structure and the ability to sustain longer, more complex thoughts in writing."}]}
